summary: Python 3.2 defined a stable ABI (PEP 384), allowing extension modules to rely on functions across different Python versions without recompilation. Added: argparse as the recommended command-line parser, unittest improvements, the faulthandler module for debugging. Security fixes continued for five years after release.
notes: Unsupported since 2016-02-20. Last micro 3.2.6. Full support ended 2013-05-13. The stable ABI was a major boon for distribution packaging.
